meta.description: Peptide-spectrum matching from MS/MS with target-decoy FDR control, framing identification confidence as a property of a ranked list (q-value/PEP) rather than a raw engine score (XCorr, hyperscore, Andromeda, SpecEValue). Covers sequence-database search engines (Comet, MS-GF+, MSFragger, Sage, MaxQuant, MetaMorpheus), concatenated vs separate target-decoy competition, PEP vs q-value, the multi-level FDR cascade, open/mass-tolerant search, rescoring (Percolator, mokapot, MS2Rescore), and pyOpenMS SimpleSearchEngineAlgorithm + FalseDiscoveryRate.
meta.audit_note: Third audit of this Skill (pre-fix and post-pass-2 reports both scored 79, Beta Only). Re-audited after pass 2 (b76ffa0, lowercase rev_ decoys) and pass 4 (6476b0e, an entire runnable DDA command-line route). All 8 inputs of the previous audit were re-run as regression tests and 2 new inputs were added. Every number below was produced by a run made on 2026-09-15 by this auditor; the fix log was read but is not treated as evidence.
meta.environment: pyOpenMS 3.5.0, pandas 3.0.5, numpy 2.5.3, Python 3.12 (shared candidate venv); Sage 0.14.6, Comet 2026.02 rev.2, MS-GF+ v2024.03.26 + MzIDToTsv (Java 17.0.19), Percolator 3.09.0, OpenMS 3.5.0 DecoyDatabase. Nothing was installed and no shared version was changed.
meta.data: SYNTHETIC with ground truth: audits/bio-proteomics-peptide-identification/data/ (make_synthetic_ms2.py, make_psm_tables.py; 600-spectrum mzML + 8 replicate seeds, 12,000-spectrum Comet-style table, separate target/decoy pair, 33-PSM pulldown). PUBLIC CC0: PXD070049 (Van Puyvelde et al., LFQ Benchmark Generation Beta), Orbitrap Astral 5-min DDA, 250 pg HYE, Conditions A/B/C REP1, submitter SDRF; FASTA uniprotkb_proteome_HYE_UniversalContaminants.fasta (31,437 entries).

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated identifiers or values. Every quantitative claim in the SKILL.md prose that this audit could test was reproduced exactly on the same public data: DecoyDatabase 31,437 -> 62,874 entries with 31,437 DECOY_; Sage 1,406 at its own spectrum_q <= 0.01 and 1,398 PSMs / 1,367 peptides after Percolator; Comet 916 raw and 1,144 / 1,138 after Percolator; MS-GF+ 656 from -log10(SpecEValue); pooled three runs 5,006 vs Sage's own 4,961; separate-search pi0-hat 0.611 -> 2,888 at 1.04% true FDP. Citations checked: picked-group FDR is now credited to Savitski 2015 / The 2022, matching the protein-inference Skill.

practice_boundaries.detail: Research proteomics only. No diagnostic, prognostic or prescriptive content about any individual anywhere in SKILL.md or usage-guide.md.

methodological_ground.detail: Target-decoy competition, (D+1)/T, pi0*D/T, mix-max routing and the PEP-vs-q guidance are all correct and were confirmed calibrated against ground truth in runs. The Skill correctly refuses a decoy FDR claim below a few hundred PSMs and states the 'do not generalise these counts' caveat on its own engine comparison.

code_usability.detail: Both pyOpenMS blocks, the concatenated table block, the separate-search block, examples/fdr_filtering.py, examples/separate_search_fdr.py and examples/dda_search.sh (both ENGINE values) all executed with exit 0. The three documented command lines (Sage, Comet, MS-GF+) and the Percolator command were executed against real Orbitrap Astral data with the flags as written.

functional_suitability.note: Completeness 3: the route is now end to end (concatenated database build, three engine command lines, Percolator rescoring, both FDR estimators, two shipped scripts), but mokapot and MS2Rescore are named in the Skill's own description and taxonomy with no command line, and examples/fdr_filtering.py is shipped but no longer referenced from SKILL.md or usage-guide.md. Correctness 4: every estimator and every quantitative claim this audit tested reproduced exactly. Appropriateness 4.

reliability.note: Fault tolerance 4: the zero-decoy ValueError guard is real and fires on both a decoy-free table and a prefix mismatch; separate_search_fdr.py additionally rejects duplicated scans and an empty decoy table. Error reporting 4: four Common Errors rows reproduced verbatim in runs (pyOpenMS TypeError, FalseDiscoveryRate RuntimeError, the empty 1% list from an untransformed E-value, the Percolator q-value column shift). Recoverability 2 tiers down to 3 short of full: examples/dda_search.sh sends Percolator's stderr to a log and runs under set -e, so a decoy-tag mismatch kills the script with nothing on the console.

performance_context.note: Token cost 3: SKILL.md grew from 243 to 366 lines with a 19-entry reference list and everything in one file; dense but nothing is filler. Execution efficiency 4: the full shipped route (database + search + Percolator + 1% list) finishes in 33 s for Sage and 27 s for Comet on a 6,135-MS2 run.

agent_usability.note: Learnability 4: a Version Compatibility header naming the five CLI versions, plus a script with a stated expected output. Consistency 4: the The-2016/The-2022 citation conflict with protein-inference is resolved. Feedback design 4: the script echoes database size and decoy count before searching. Error prevention 3: the per-tool decoy-tag table, the score-orientation comment and the doubled-decoy row are genuinely preventive, but the zero-decoy guard now hard-stops on a legitimately decoy-free small table where the pre-fix version usefully showed the q floor instead.

human_usability.note: Discoverability 3: the frontmatter description is long and jargon-dense, unchanged from the pre-fix version. Forgiveness 4: the failure modes a human is most likely to hit each have an explicit Common Errors row with the real message text.

security.note: Credential safety 4, input validation 3, data safety 4. No eval/exec, no network calls, no credentials. examples/dda_search.sh uses set -euo pipefail and parameter-expansion guards on its required variables; its only file-modifying step is a sed over comet.params.new into its own output directory.

maintainability.note: Modularity 3: one 366-line SKILL.md plus three examples, no references/ split. Modifiability 4: every tool path in dda_search.sh is an overridable environment variable, which is how this audit ran it unchanged. Testability 4: both new scripts print numbers a re-auditor can check, and separate_search_fdr.py prints a ground-truth FDP when the table carries is_correct.

agent_specific.note: Trigger precision 4, composability 4 (clean hand-offs to protein-inference, ptm-analysis, dia-analysis, quantification, data-import), idempotency 4 (Percolator on the same pin is byte-identical across runs), escape hatches 4. Progressive disclosure 3: the whole Skill is one file, so an agent loads all 366 lines whether it needs the CLI route or only the table snippet.

key_strengths: The P1 that capped the previous two audits is definitively fixed: the table snippet now finds lowercase rev_ decoys on synthetic FragPipe-style data (3,813 of 3,813) and on a real Sage search of public data (222 of 222), and reproduces Sage's own q-value list scan for scan.

The Skill now carries a complete, executable DDA route. Every command block was run as written on real Orbitrap Astral data: OpenMS DecoyDatabase, Sage, Comet, MS-GF+ and Percolator, plus a 117-line shipped script that runs the whole chain in 33 seconds.

Every quantitative claim in the prose that could be tested reproduced exactly - 1,398/1,367, 1,144/1,138, 916, 656, 5,006 vs 4,961, 31,437 -> 62,874, pi0-hat 0.611 -> 2,888 at 1.04% FDP. That is unusually strong provenance for a Skill's stated numbers.

The failure modes are now guarded in code rather than only in prose: a zero-decoy table raises, a wrong score orientation returns an empty list rather than a wrong one, and the Percolator q-value column is located by header name (an index read would have given 885 instead of 1,144).

Estimator-to-search-mode matching is correct and now backed by running code on both sides: (D+1)/T for concatenated competition, pi0*D/T for separate searches, with Percolator's -y/-Y semantics verified against the installed 3.09.0 binary's own help text.

recommendations.title: dda_search.sh hides Percolator's error from the operator
recommendations.problem: With a decoy-tag mismatch, Percolator correctly exits 1 with 'Error: no decoy PSMs were provided', but the script redirects its stderr to $OUT/percolator.log and dies under set -e, so the console shows the search completing and then nothing - no counts, no message.
recommendations.root_cause: The 2> redirect was added to keep Percolator's long banner off the console, and no trap or tee was added with it.
recommendations.fix: Replace the redirect with `2> >(tee "$OUT/percolator.log" >&2)` or add a `trap 'tail -3 "$OUT/percolator.log" >&2' ERR`, and add a pre-flight check that the pin's Label column contains both 1 and -1 before calling Percolator.

recommendations.title: No shipped route for the multi-run pooling the Skill advises
recommendations.problem: The Skill states, correctly and with numbers this audit reproduced, that Percolator needs pooled runs to beat an engine's own score, but dda_search.sh accepts one MZML and the sample Sage JSON shows one mzml path.
recommendations.root_cause: The script was written around the single-run comparison used to generate the engine-comparison paragraph.
recommendations.fix: Let MZML hold several space-separated paths, pass them all to `sage` and loop the Comet call, and note that Comet's pins must be concatenated (header once) before Percolator.

recommendations.title: Zero-decoy stop loses the q-floor hint on tiny lists
recommendations.problem: A genuinely decoy-free 33-PSM pulldown export now raises ValueError. The pre-fix behaviour returned a q floor of 0.0303, which told the operator directly that 1% is unreachable at this list size - the exact point the Skill's own Decision Tree makes.
recommendations.root_cause: The guard added in pass 2 treats 'no decoys' as unconditionally an error rather than distinguishing a prefix mismatch from an already-filtered table.
recommendations.fix: Keep the raise, but put the attainable floor in the message: `raise ValueError(f'no decoy PSMs recognised in {len(psms)} rows: check the decoy prefix, or the table was already decoy-filtered (with no decoys the smallest reachable q is 1/{len(psms)} = {1/len(psms):.3f})')`.

recommendations.title: mokapot and MS2Rescore promised but not routed
recommendations.problem: The frontmatter description and the tool taxonomy both advertise rescoring via mokapot and MS2Rescore, but only Percolator has a command line. mokapot 0.10.0 is installed and takes the same Sage pin.
recommendations.root_cause: Pass 4 deliberately scoped rescoring to one tool to avoid adding surface.
recommendations.fix: Add a two-line mokapot invocation next to the Percolator block (`mokapot --dest_dir ... results.sage.pin`) and state that it consumes the identical pin, or drop MS2Rescore from the description so the description matches what ships.
